newsitem.title: GREECE: OTE Telecom completes rights issue.
newsitem.headline: OTE Telecom completes rights issue.

text.p: Greece's OTE telecom raised 189.9 billion drachmas ($667.5 million) through a six-for-80 rights issue of 31.65 million shares at 6,000 drachmas between June 26 and July 18, the company said in a statement.
Retail and institutional investors exercised 97.97 and 93.0 percent of their rights respectively, said OTE. The issue raises the number of shares oustanding by 7.5 percent.
The rights issue, by far the largest ever carried out in the Greek capital market, was fully underwriten by Greece's National Bank, Salomon Brothers International Ltd and HSBC Investment Banking.
The Greek state fully exercised its rights but offered retail investors additional rights at a low price to round up their new stake in OTE's share capital to a mimimum trading lot of 10 shares.
Rights corresponding to another 3.0 million shares were also privately placed with OTE's personnel and pensioners.

Greece part-floated 53.44 million shares -- 12.66 percent -- of OTE in mid-June through a private placement with international institutional investors and a public offering which were oversubscribed three times.
Foreign portfolios snapped up 48 percent of the part-floated shares with domestic institutionals and retail investors being alloted 17 and 35 percent respectively.
Retail investors were offered OTE's shares at 6,400 drachmas, 200 drachmas below what institutional investors paid through a book-building.
Following the part-float and the rights issue, OTE's free-float is estimated at around 20 percent from 7.57 percent, but may not rise above 25 percent pursuant to legislation.

OTE is expected to beat earlier projections of 304.4 billion drachmas in pretax earnings, posting profit in excess of 320 billion this year from 250.1 billion in 1996. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4 ($ = 284.5 Greek Drachmas)
